name: Playback Info Card
description: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.
overview: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.4.0 - Corrective patch: complete in-place replacement of Jellyfin 12.1 Devices widget with strict exclusion of navigation drawer links, zero top-of-page fallback, connected devices preservation, and accessible 22-field technical breakdown drawer with distinct Source/Output resolution and container telemetry.

Release v0.2.3.7 - Telemetry accuracy corrections: Remux and Direct Stream separation in header counts, strict QSV/HW engine suppression when video is direct, truthful framerate parsing (rejection of ffmpeg throughput counter 2191 fps), server-reported transcode reasons without speculative inference, TV series artwork fallback, and accessible 21-field technical breakdown drawer.
Release v0.2.3.6 - In-place replacement of modern Jellyfin 12.1 React/MUI Devices widget, zero top-of-page fallback, connected devices visibility, and No active playback empty state.

Release v0.2.3.5 - Corrective patch completely replacing stock Devices section with NOW PLAYING card on Jellyfin Dashboard, with empty state No active playback, autonomous loading, and zero duplicate mounting.
Release v0.2.3.4 - Restore primary default Dashboard integration above Devices section, autonomous loading, session count summary, compact mode default, and transcode breakdown.
Release v0.2.3.3 - Fix notification route dispatch, preserve partial settings, protect masked secrets, and refine diagnostics.
Release v0.2.3.2 - Native Discord/Telegram notifications, transcode details, and My Playback view.
Release v0.2.3.1 - Safe internal monitor page, local diagnostics, and issue reporting.
